title: Bee Removal in Murray Hill, Manhattan
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Murray Hill, Manhattan. Licensed technicians. Wall void nests treated and sealed. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Murray Hill's mix of historic brownstones, high-rise apartments, and bustling commercial spaces creates numerous opportunities for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees to establish nests in unexpected places. When an active nest is discovered in your Murray Hill property — whether in a Park Avenue co-op wall void, a townhouse soffit near the Morgan Library, or a commercial building along Third Avenue — you need swift, professional nest treatment and removal to ensure safety. The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp and hornet removal services throughout Murray Hill, treating active nests and sealing entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has been serving Murray Hill's diverse residential and commercial properties for years, understanding the unique challenges of bee infestations in both pre-war buildings and modern high-rises. Our licensed technicians use safe, effective methods to remove bee colonies while prioritizing humane relocation when feasible, and we offer same-day emergency service to address urgent situations in this densely populated Manhattan neighborhood.
localContext: Murray Hill's tree-lined streets, rooftop gardens, and proximity to green spaces like the East River Esplanade make it an attractive area for wasps and hornets seeking nesting sites. The neighborhood's mix of architectural styles — from converted carriage houses to modern luxury towers — means wasp and hornet colonies can establish paper nests in building facades, air conditioning units, window boxes, and ventilation systems throughout the area between 34th and 42nd Streets. Yellow jackets frequently nest in ground burrows near building foundations and in wall voids where siding meets brick. Carpenter bees bore into trim and wooden architectural details on brownstones and historic structures.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Murray Hill?

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Murray Hill?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves. The overwhelming majority of nest calls in Murray Hill involve wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, or carpenter bees — all of which we treat, remove, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
